authority.requirement: Critical browser E2E must exercise production auth/security behavior; production Secure/device-binding policy must not be weakened.

finding: browser seed did not persist deviceBindingHash
tests navigated HTTP while Secure cookies were scoped to HTTPS

changes: Seeded deterministic test-only device-binding tokens and matching SHA-256 hashes.
Added production-named Secure device-binding cookies to browser contexts.
Moved browser target to https://localhost:3443 with certificate errors ignored only by test contexts.
Added a CI-only TLS boundary forwarding to the production Next server; production cookie settings remain unchanged.
Added negative browser checks for missing and incorrect binding => 403 DEVICE_MISMATCH.
Added contract regression checks for the secure browser fixture.

risks: Exact-head GitHub Actions execution evidence is still required.
CI runner must provide apt/openssl/socat networking capability for the test-only TLS boundary.
